faq.q: What is a titanium pcb edge grip?
faq.a: A titanium pcb edge grip is a precision-machined plating rack component used in high-density board edge grip for pcb plating. Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium pcb edge grip?
faq.a: Titanium PCB Edge Grip is designed for high-density board edge grip for pcb plating. The Grade 2 CP-Ti grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium pcb edge grip manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium PCB Edge Grip is manufactured using Expanded mesh forming. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium pcb edge grip?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
